# Israel TV

> A free addon that brings Israeli TV — Keshet 12 (Mako), Reshet 13, Kan 11, Kan Kids & Teens and 16 live channels —
> into the Stremio and Nuvio apps. Most people only install the public link
> https://israel-tv.israeltv2.workers.dev/manifest.json. Keshet 12, and Israel-only episodes when abroad, need a small
> self-hosted "home helper" (the resolver) on the viewer's own network. Anyone can also run the whole thing
> (at home, or on a free Cloudflare account). TypeScript/Node 24 monorepo, AGPL-3.0, no accounts, hosts no video.

## Setting it up for someone

- [Guide for AI assistants](docs/setup/for-agents.md): questions to ask first, exact commands, how to verify, what never to do
